author: orchestrator
summary: research a router LLM that decides whether to call Haiku, Sonnet, or Opus based on query complexity. Build something that goes beyond what is already existing and outperforms the baselines that already exist.
seed: research a router LLM that decides whether to call Haiku, Sonnet, or Opus based on query complexity. Build something that goes beyond what is already existing and outperforms the baselines that already exist.

author: idea-expander
summary: Probing-classifier routing: lightweight MLP on frozen embeddings achieves ≥5% cost reduction at iso-quality vs always-Sonnet
claim: A lightweight 2-layer MLP probing classifier trained on frozen sentence embeddings routes queries to {Haiku, Sonnet, Opus} achieving ≥5% reduction in cost-per-quality-point vs always-Sonnet at iso-quality on MMLU-style benchmarks.

author: idea-expander
summary: [CROSS-DOMAIN] Speculative cascade routing (transplant from speculative decoding): draft-then-verify achieves ≥10% cost reduction vs always-Sonnet at ≤1% quality drop
claim: A draft-then-verify cascade (Haiku drafts → verifier decides escalation → Sonnet/Opus fallback) inspired by speculative decoding in HW inference systems achieves ≥10% cost reduction vs always-Sonnet with at most 1% quality degradation on MMLU.

author: idea-expander
summary: Online contextual bandit router (LinUCB) achieves ≥3pp better routing accuracy on OOD queries vs static trained classifier
claim: A contextual bandit router using LinUCB with query embeddings as context and answer quality as reward adapts to distribution shift, achieving ≥3pp higher routing accuracy on OOD query sets vs a static MLP classifier trained offline.

author: idea-expander
summary: Multi-signal feature fusion (syntax depth + NER count + CoT indicators + domain embedding) improves routing F1 by ≥4pp over embedding-only baseline
claim: Augmenting query representations with structured linguistic signals (dependency parse depth, NER count, CoT indicators, domain embedding) improves routing F1 on a complexity-labeled benchmark by ≥4pp vs raw sentence embedding baseline.

author: idea-expander
summary: Utility-maximizing router with learned quality-cost tradeoff curve achieves Pareto dominance at ≥60% of tested budget levels vs fixed-threshold routing
claim: A router that maximizes U=quality-λ·cost with a learned quality-cost tradeoff curve achieves Pareto-dominant cost-quality tradeoff vs fixed-threshold routing at ≥60% of tested per-query budget levels on a mixed-difficulty benchmark.
